Channel Info
OPNA_GetChannelCount
inline u8 OPNA_GetChannelCount()
View source

Get the number of OPNA channels: 3 SSG channels, 6 FM channels, 6 rhythm instruments and the ADPCM channel Note: OPNA_USE_CHANNEL need to be set to TRUE to use this function

Return

Number of channels

OPNA_GetChannelVolume
u8 OPNA_GetChannelVolume(
u8 
chan
)
View source

Get the current volume of a given channel (based on the values written with OPNA_Set*Register functions) - SSG: channel volume (15 if controlled by the envelope) - FM: slot 4 operator level - Rhythm: rhythm and instrument levels. Rhythm sounds have no key off, so the volume is only returned once after each key on (0 for next calls) - ADPCM: output level while ADPCM is playing Note: OPNA_USE_CHANNEL need to be set to TRUE to use this function

Parameters
chan
u8

Channel index: 0 to 2 for SSG A-C, 3 to 8 for FM channel 1-6, 9 to 14 for bass drum, snare drum, top cymbal, high hat, tom-tom and rim shot, 15 for ADPCM

Return

Volume from 0 (mute) to 15 (max). 0 if the channel is not in use (tone and noise disabled, key off, outputs disabled or ADPCM not playing)

ADPCM
OPNA_ADPCMLoad
void OPNA_ADPCMLoad(
const 
u8* 
data,
u16 
addr,
u16 
size
)
View source

Write ADPCM data into the cartridge sample RAM Addresses are in memory units of 4 bytes (x1-bit DRAM), so 16-bit covers the 256 KB of the OPNA Note: OPNA_USE_ADPCM need to be set to TRUE to use this function Note: ADPCM playback is stopped, and no other OPNA access (e.g. music replayer in interrupt) must occur during the load

Parameters
data
const u8*

Pointer to the ADPCM data to load

addr
u16

Start address in RAM (in 4 bytes unit)

size
u16

Data size (in 4 bytes unit)
